name: bwinkeler-aquarium
description: Aquarium (service_id: aquarium): children's paper drawings swim on a TV. Part of the bwinkeler.com platform.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @bwinkeler-aquarium/shared && npm run build -w @bwinkeler-aquarium/backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @bwinkeler-aquarium/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @bwinkeler-aquarium/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.validate: npm run format && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run check:es5
